verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents a TOML config file with imports, live reload, and IPC via `alacritty msg`. It has no first-party way to version, review, or roll back automations. Keeping the plain-text config under external version control would be a user-side workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
